name: rheono
description: Check a live app's security posture before you ship: TLS, headers, cookies, exposed paths.

interface.longDescription: Checks a live app's security posture just before you deploy: TLS certificate state, missing security headers, cookie flags, server version disclosure and conventionally exposed admin, debug and environment paths. Read-only and shallow, answers in seconds, and never changes the target. Works on any public URL; a domain can be proven by DNS TXT so later checks reference it as an owned asset. The deeper probe and the email report come from request_pentest.
capabilities: Check a URL's TLS and headers
defaultPrompt: Is this app ready to ship?
Check the security headers on my staging URL
Verify this domain is mine before you check it
